records.text: Erika Frantzve says she was self-taught in fashion and graduated in political science and international relations.
records.speaker: Erika Kirk

appearances.snippet: I did not go to fashion school, but I am self-taught, so I graduated with political science and international relations, and although that background to some might seem a little bit foreign to the fashion world, I think that it's actually very helpful because...

verification.notes: The audition clip confirms Erika described herself as self-taught and said she graduated in political science and international relations. Public reporting supports a political-science major, while ASU's official 2012 catalog shows international relations as coursework within political science rather than a standalone bachelor's major; self-taught fashion ability is inherently difficult to verify.

sources.title: Arizona State University 2012-2013 archived catalog
sources.relevance: Shows Political Science BS and international-relations coursework but no standalone International Relations major.

records.text: Erika Frantzve says she comes from a family of entrepreneurs, learned how to run a company from her mother, and used that knowledge to formulate her nonprofit.
records.speaker: Erika Kirk

appearances.snippet: We run a company and that's how I was able to formulate my nonprofit and that's what also made me change my major because originally I was business.

verification.notes: Public profiles confirm Erika founded Everyday Heroes Like You and describe Lori Frantzve as a businesswoman whose example influenced her. The broader bloodline-of-entrepreneurs claim and the precise causal assertion that those lessons formulated the nonprofit are personal characterizations not independently verifiable.

sources.title: Arizona Foothills - AZ Giving Spotlight: Erika Frantzve
sources.relevance: Confirms Erika founded the nonprofit and credits her mother's giving lessons.

records.text: Erika Kirk auditioned for the fashion reality program House of DVF, which ran for two seasons in 2014 and 2015.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I can also show you because like I said this was her this was the year where she was just like I got to get famous somehow she also auditions for this show which we think is Diane von Furstenberg had a show called House of DVF it's fashion which ran for two seasons from 2014-2015 and Erika (Erika Kirk) auditions for that as well take a listen.

verification.notes: The source transcript plays Erika Kirk/Frantzve auditioning for House of DVF, while contemporaneous entertainment coverage confirms the fashion reality program and its second season. The audition is therefore supported by primary source footage; confidence is medium because the external article documents the show rather than identifying her audition.
